#### 2021 Census demographics by dissemination block ####
# StatCan only publishes population, dwellings and households at the
# dissemination-block (DB) level. Everything else (dwelling type, income,
# immigration, age, tenure) is released for dissemination areas (DAs), so we
# pull the DA profile and attach it to every block inside that DA. Density is
# the one measure computed at true block resolution.
# Requires CM_API_KEY in ~/.Renviron (set via cancensus::set_cancensus_api_key()).
library(cancensus)

edmonton_csd <- list(CSD = "4811061")

census_vectors <- c(
  # Structural type of dwelling (occupied private dwellings)
  dwell_total     = "v_CA21_434",
  single_detached = "v_CA21_435",
  semi_detached   = "v_CA21_436",
  row_house       = "v_CA21_437",
  duplex_apt      = "v_CA21_438",
  lowrise_apt     = "v_CA21_439", # apartment, fewer than 5 storeys
  tower_apt       = "v_CA21_440", # apartment, 5 or more storeys
  other_attached  = "v_CA21_441",
  movable         = "v_CA21_442",
  # Income
  median_hh_income = "v_CA21_906",
  # Immigration status (population in private households)
  imm_total      = "v_CA21_4404",
  non_immigrants = "v_CA21_4407",
  immigrants     = "v_CA21_4410",
  non_permanent  = "v_CA21_4434",
  # Age
  age_total  = "v_CA21_8",
  age_0_14   = "v_CA21_11",
  age_65plus = "v_CA21_251",
  median_age = "v_CA21_389",
  # Tenure
  tenure_total = "v_CA21_4237",
  owner        = "v_CA21_4238",
  renter       = "v_CA21_4239",
  # Period of construction (occupied private dwellings)
  built_pre1961   = "v_CA21_4264",
  built_1961_1980 = "v_CA21_4265",
  built_1981_1990 = "v_CA21_4266",
  built_1991_2000 = "v_CA21_4267",
  built_2001_2005 = "v_CA21_4268",
  built_2006_2010 = "v_CA21_4269",
  built_2011_2015 = "v_CA21_4270",
  built_2016_2021 = "v_CA21_4271",
  # Household type (private households)
  hh_total           = "v_CA21_543",
  hh_couple_kids     = "v_CA21_546",
  hh_couple_no_kids  = "v_CA21_547",
  hh_one_parent      = "v_CA21_548",
  hh_multigen        = "v_CA21_549",
  hh_multi_family    = "v_CA21_550",
  hh_family_plus     = "v_CA21_551", # one family with additional persons
  hh_roommates       = "v_CA21_552", # two or more people, not a family
  hh_one_person      = "v_CA21_553"
)

# Census only gives period-of-construction counts, so average dwelling age is
# estimated from each period's midpoint year (1950 assumed for "1960 or before").
built_midpoints <- c(built_pre1961 = 1950, built_1961_1980 = 1970.5,
                     built_1981_1990 = 1985.5, built_1991_2000 = 1995.5,
                     built_2001_2005 = 2003, built_2006_2010 = 2008,
                     built_2011_2015 = 2013, built_2016_2021 = 2018.5)
avg_dwelling_age <- function(df) {
  counts <- as.matrix(as.data.frame(df)[names(built_midpoints)])
  2021 - drop(counts %*% built_midpoints) / rowSums(counts)
}

da_census <- get_census(dataset = "CA21", regions = edmonton_csd, level = "DA",
                        vectors = census_vectors, quiet = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(avg_dwelling_age = avg_dwelling_age(.)) %>%
  transmute(
    DA_UID = GeoUID,
    da_population = Population,
    pct_single_detached = single_detached / dwell_total,
    pct_semi_detached   = semi_detached / dwell_total,
    pct_row_house       = row_house / dwell_total,
    pct_duplex          = duplex_apt / dwell_total,
    pct_lowrise_apt     = lowrise_apt / dwell_total,
    pct_tower           = tower_apt / dwell_total,
    pct_other_dwelling  = (other_attached + movable) / dwell_total,
    median_hh_income,
    pct_immigrant     = immigrants / imm_total,
    pct_non_permanent = non_permanent / imm_total,
    pct_age_0_14   = age_0_14 / age_total,
    pct_age_65plus = age_65plus / age_total,
    median_age,
    pct_owner  = owner / tenure_total,
    pct_renter = renter / tenure_total,
    renter = renter,
    tenure_total = tenure_total,
    avg_dwelling_age,
    pct_hh_couple_kids    = hh_couple_kids / hh_total,
    pct_hh_couple_no_kids = hh_couple_no_kids / hh_total,
    pct_hh_one_parent     = hh_one_parent / hh_total,
    pct_hh_one_person     = hh_one_person / hh_total,
    pct_hh_multigen       = hh_multigen / hh_total,
    pct_hh_roommates      = hh_roommates / hh_total,
    pct_hh_other_family   = (hh_multi_family + hh_family_plus) / hh_total
  ) %>%
  # Suppressed / zero-population DAs give 0/0; keep them as NA, not NaN
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ ifelse(is.finite(.x), .x, NA_real_)))

db_census <- get_census(dataset = "CA21", regions = edmonton_csd, level = "DB",
                        geo_format = "sf", quiet = TRUE) %>%
  transmute(
    DB_UID = GeoUID,
    DA_UID,
    db_population = Population,
    db_dwellings  = Dwellings,
    area_km2      = `Shape Area`,
    pop_density   = ifelse(area_km2 > 0, db_population / area_km2, NA_real_),       # people / km²
    dwelling_density = ifelse(area_km2 > 0, db_dwellings / area_km2, NA_real_)      # dwellings / km²
  ) %>%
  left_join(da_census, by = "DA_UID") %>%
  st_transform(crs = 4326)

alberta_crs <- 3400 # NAD83 / Alberta 10-TM (Forest), metres


#### Census map layers ####
# Every stat gets its own radio button in the layer control, but they all share
# ONE polygon layer: each block carries a pre-computed fill colour per stat
# (col_<key>) and the onRender JS below recolours the polygons and swaps the
# legend when the radio button changes. Drawing 15 copies of 7,000+ polygons
# (each with its own popups) would make the page far too heavy for Safari.
db_census_map <- ms_simplify(db_census, keep = 0.2, keep_shapes = TRUE)

# Permits (2024+, filtered above) per block and building type, counted against
# the full-resolution block polygons so simplification can't shift any points.
permit_types <- sort(unique(na.omit(permits$building_type)))
db_permit_counts <- permits %>%
  filter(!st_is_empty(geometry)) %>%
  st_join(select(db_census, DB_UID), join = st_within) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(!is.na(DB_UID), !is.na(building_type)) %>%
  count(DB_UID, building_type) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = building_type, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)

db_demos_count <- demos %>% 
  select(Demolition, geometry) %>% 
  filter(!st_is_empty(geometry)) %>%
  st_join(select(db_census, DB_UID), join = st_within) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(!is.na(DB_UID), !is.na(Demolition)) %>%
  count(DB_UID, Demolition) %>% 
  filter(Demolition == 1) %>% 
  select(-Demolition) %>% 
  rename(Demolition = n)


# 2024+ permits by zone, using the permit's own `zoning` field rather than a
# spatial join: about half of these permits (most of them since 2025) have no
# coordinates, but nearly all record the zone they were issued under, which is
# already the 2024 bylaw. Permits spanning several lots list more than one zone
# ("RSF, RSM"); the first is used.
zoning_2024 <- permits %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(zone_2024 = str_extract(zoning, "^[^,]+"),
         zone = case_when(zone_2024 == "RS" ~ "RS",
                          zone_2024 == "RSF" ~ "RSF",
                          TRUE ~ "Other"),
         units = as.numeric(units_added)) %>%
  group_by(zone, building_type) %>%
  summarise(permits = n(), units = sum(units, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Share of each zone's permits, and of its new units, by building type. One
# row-house or apartment permit can cover many units, so the two differ.
# `total` is the zone's share of all permits (or units) citywide.
zoning_2024 %>%
  pivot_longer(c(permits, units), names_to = "measure") %>%
  group_by(measure) %>%
  mutate(city_total = sum(value)) %>%
  group_by(zone, measure) %>%
  mutate(total = sum(value) / city_total,
         value = value / sum(value)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-city_total) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = building_type, values_from = value, values_fill = 0) %>%
  arrange(measure, zone)
permits_table <- permits %>%

         zone = case_when(zone_2024 == "RS" ~ "RS",

                          TRUE ~ "Other"),
         units = as.numeric(units_added)) 

permits_table %>%

permits_table %>%

# 2016-2023 permits by the zone they sit in on the CURRENT zoning map.
# Points go first so each permit picks up the zone polygon it falls inside;

zoning_2016 <- permits_2016 %>%
  filter(!st_is_empty(geometry)) %>%
  st_transform(crs = alberta_crs) %>%
  st_join(zoning %>%
            st_make_valid() %>%  # repair duplicate vertices, self-intersections, etc.
            st_transform(crs = alberta_crs) %>%
            select(zone_2024 = zoning),
          join = st_within) %>%

  mutate(zone = case_when(zone_2024 == "RS" ~ "RS",
                          zone_2024 == "RSF" ~ "RSF",
                          TRUE ~ "Other"),
         units = as.numeric(units_added)) %>%
  group_by(zone, building_type) %>%
  summarise(permits = n(), units = sum(units, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

zoning_2016 %>%

  ungroup() %>%

  pivot_wider(names_from = building_type, values_from = value, values_fill = 0) %>%

  left_join(db_permit_counts, by = "DB_UID") %>%

  left_join(db_demos_count, by = "DB_UID")

  mutate(percent_demo = ifelse(is.na(Demolition), 0, Demolition/db_dwellings))

  st_drop_geometry() %>%

  summarise(across(`Row House`:permits_total, \(x)sum(x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%

# Zoning designation for each DA on the 2024 map: the share of its zoned land
# in RS, RSF and every other zone, and whichever of the three covers the most.
# Blocks are overlaid on the zoning polygons and the pieces summed by DA.
# Coordinates are rounded to the centimetre so GEOS doesn't choke on the
# overlay.
da_zoning <- db_census %>%
  select(DA_UID) %>%
  st_transform(alberta_crs) %>%
  st_set_precision(100) %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  st_intersection(zoning %>%
                    st_transform(alberta_crs) %>%
                    st_set_precision(100) %>%
                    st_make_valid() %>%
                    transmute(zone = case_when(zoning == "RS" ~ "RS",
                                               zoning == "RSF" ~ "RSF",
                                               TRUE ~ "Other"))) %>%
  mutate(area = as.numeric(st_area(geometry))) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(DA_UID, zone) %>%
  summarise(area = sum(area), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(DA_UID) %>%
  mutate(share = area / sum(area),
         zone_designation = zone[which.max(share)]) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-area) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = zone, names_prefix = "pct_zone_",
              values_from = share, values_fill = 0)

da_permit_counts <- da_permit_counts %>%
  left_join(da_zoning, by = "DA_UID")


da_permit_counts %>% 
  group_by(zone_designation) %>% 
  summarise(age = mean(median_hh_income, na.rm = TRUE))

da_permit_counts %>% 
  mutate(Apartment_p = ifelse(Apartment > 0, "yes", "no"),
         Row_House_p = ifelse(`Row House` > 0, "yes", "no"),
         Duplex_p = ifelse(`Duplex/Semi-Detatched` > 0, "yes", "no"),
         Backyard_p = ifelse(`Backyard House` > 0, "yes", "no"),
         Mixed_use_p = ifelse(`Mixed Use` > 0, "yes", "no")) %>% 
  pivot_longer(c(Apartment_p,
                 Row_House_p,
                 Duplex_p,
                 Backyard_p,
                 Mixed_use_p),
               names_to = "Housing_type", values_to = "Present") %>% 
  mutate(Housing_type = paste(Housing_type, Present, sep = "_")) %>% 
  group_by(Housing_type, zone_designation) %>% 
  summarise(Income = mean(median_hh_income, na.rm = TRUE),
            Housing_age = mean(avg_dwelling_age, na.rm = TRUE),
            percent_rent = sum(renter, na.rm = TRUE)/sum(tenure_total, na.rm = TRUE))
census_layers <- list(
  list(key = "pop_density", label = "Population density",
       bins = c(0, 1000, 2500, 5000, 10000), unit = " /km²"),
  list(key = "dwelling_density", label = "Dwelling density",
       bins = c(0, 400, 1000, 2000, 4000), unit = " /km²"),
  list(key = "pct_single_detached", label = "Single-detached houses", share = TRUE),
  list(key = "pct_semi_detached",   label = "Semi-detached houses",   share = TRUE),
  list(key = "pct_row_house",       label = "Row houses",             share = TRUE),
  list(key = "pct_duplex",          label = "Duplex apartments",      share = TRUE),
  list(key = "pct_lowrise_apt",     label = "Low-rise apartments (<5 storeys)", share = TRUE),
  list(key = "pct_tower",           label = "Towers (5+ storeys)",    share = TRUE),
  list(key = "median_hh_income",    label = "Median household income", prefix = "$"),
  list(key = "pct_immigrant",       label = "Immigrants",             share = TRUE),
  list(key = "pct_non_permanent",   label = "Non-permanent residents", share = TRUE),
  list(key = "median_age",          label = "Median age"),
  list(key = "pct_age_0_14",        label = "Children (0-14)",        share = TRUE),
  list(key = "pct_age_65plus",      label = "Seniors (65+)",          share = TRUE),
  list(key = "pct_owner",           label = "Homeowners",             share = TRUE),
  list(key = "avg_dwelling_age",    label = "Average dwelling age (est.)", unit = " yrs")
)
census_na_colour <- "#d9d9d9"

# Build each stat's palette, per-block colours and legend entries.
census_layers <- lapply(census_layers, function(layer) {
  x <- db_census_map[[layer$key]]
  if (!is.null(layer$bins)) {
    # Fixed bins with an open top (and optionally an open bottom, -Inf), so a
    # few tiny, crowded blocks don't wash out the scale
    b <- layer$bins
    pal <- colorBin(layer$palette %||% "YlGnBu", domain = NULL, bins = c(b, Inf),
                    na.color = census_na_colour)
    layer$colours <- pal(x)
    layer$legend_colours <- pal(ifelse(is.finite(b), b, b[2] - 1))
    fmt <- if (isTRUE(layer$share)) label_percent(accuracy = 1) else label_comma()
    lower <- b
    upper <- c(b[-1], Inf)
    layer$legend_labels <- case_when(
      is.infinite(lower) ~ paste0("< ", fmt(upper)),
      is.infinite(upper) ~ paste0(fmt(lower), "+"),
      TRUE ~ paste0(fmt(lower), " – ", fmt(upper))
    ) |> paste0(layer$unit %||% "")
  } else {
    # Continuous scale clipped to the 2nd–98th percentile (0–98th for shares)
    lims <- unname(quantile(x, c(0.02, 0.98), na.rm = TRUE))
    if (isTRUE(layer$share)) lims[1] <- 0
    pal <- colorNumeric("YlGnBu", domain = lims, na.color = census_na_colour)
    layer$colours <- pal(pmin(pmax(x, lims[1]), lims[2]))
    breaks <- pretty(lims, n = 5)
    breaks <- breaks[breaks >= lims[1] & breaks <= lims[2]]
    layer$legend_colours <- pal(breaks)
    layer$legend_labels <- if (isTRUE(layer$share)) {
      percent(breaks, accuracy = 1)
    } else {
      paste0(layer$prefix %||% "", comma(breaks), layer$unit %||% "")
    }
  }
  layer
})
census_keys   <- vapply(census_layers, `[[`, "", "key")
census_labels <- vapply(census_layers, `[[`, "", "label")
# Each stat's colours as a short palette plus a palette index per block, which
# is much smaller in the page than a full colour string for every block.
census_colours <- setNames(lapply(census_layers, function(layer) {
  pal <- unique(layer$colours)
  list(pal = pal, idx = match(layer$colours, pal) - 1L)
}), census_keys)

# Popups are built in the browser (onRender below) from these columns rather
# than embedding a finished HTML string for every block; percentages are
# rounded to whole numbers here.
pct <- function(x) round(x * 100)
census_popup <- db_census_map %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  transmute(
    db = DB_UID, da = DA_UID,
    pop = db_population,
    pop_density = round(pop_density),
    dwelling_density = round(dwelling_density),
    single = pct(pct_single_detached), semi = pct(pct_semi_detached),
    row = pct(pct_row_house), duplex = pct(pct_duplex),
    lowrise = pct(pct_lowrise_apt), tower = pct(pct_tower),
    dwelling_age = round(avg_dwelling_age),
    income = round(median_hh_income),
    immigrant = pct(pct_immigrant), non_permanent = pct(pct_non_permanent),
    median_age = round(median_age, 1),
    age_0_14 = pct(pct_age_0_14), age_65plus = pct(pct_age_65plus),
    owner = pct(pct_owner), renter = pct(pct_renter),
    permits_total
  ) %>%
  as.list()
census_popup$permits <- unname(lapply(permit_types, \(t) db_census_map[[t]]))

# One legend per stat; the onRender JS shows only the active one.
add_census_legends <- function(map) {
  for (layer in census_layers) {
    map <- map |>
      addLegend(position = "bottomleft",
                colors = c(layer$legend_colours, census_na_colour),
                labels = c(layer$legend_labels, "No data"),
                title = layer$label, opacity = 0.7,
                className = paste0("info legend census-legend legend-", layer$key))
  }
  map
}

# Current (2024 bylaw) zoning, grouped into a few broad classes for colour;
# the popup keeps the full zone code. Zones carry modifiers ("RM h16",
# "MU h40 f7 cf"), so classes go by the base code before the first space.
zoning_valid <- zoning %>%
  st_transform(crs = alberta_crs) %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  mutate(zone_id = row_number())

# Permits (2024+) per zoning polygon and building type, counted against the
# full-resolution polygons. Only permits with coordinates can be placed.
zone_permit_counts <- permits %>%
  filter(!st_is_empty(geometry), !is.na(building_type)) %>%
  st_transform(crs = alberta_crs) %>%
  st_join(select(zoning_valid, zone_id), join = st_within) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(!is.na(zone_id)) %>%
  count(zone_id, building_type) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = building_type, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)

# Simplified with a 2 m tolerance to keep the page light (rmapshaper returns
# nothing for this layer).
zoning_map <- zoning_valid %>%
  left_join(zone_permit_counts, by = "zone_id") %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(permit_types), ~ coalesce(.x, 0L)),
         permits_total = rowSums(across(all_of(permit_types)))) %>%
  st_simplify(preserveTopology = TRUE, dTolerance = 2) %>%
  # Repairs can leave geometry collections, which leaflet can't draw
  st_collection_extract("POLYGON") %>%
  st_transform(crs = 4326) %>%
  mutate(base_zone = str_extract(zoning, "^[^ ]+"),
         zone_class = case_when(base_zone == "RS"  ~ "RS - Small Scale Residential",
                                base_zone == "RSF" ~ "RSF - Small Scale Flex Residential",
                                base_zone == "RSM" ~ "RSM - Small-Medium Scale Residential",
                                base_zone == "RM"  ~ "RM - Medium Scale Residential",
                                base_zone == "RL"  ~ "RL - Large Scale Residential",
                                base_zone == "MU"  ~ "MU - Mixed Use",
                                base_zone %in% c("CN", "CG", "CB") ~ "Commercial",
                                base_zone %in% c("DC", "DC1", "DC2") ~ "Direct Control",
                                TRUE ~ "Other"),
         zone_class = factor(zone_class, levels = c(
           "RS - Small Scale Residential", "RSF - Small Scale Flex Residential",
           "RSM - Small-Medium Scale Residential", "RM - Medium Scale Residential",
           "RL - Large Scale Residential", "MU - Mixed Use", "Commercial",
           "Direct Control", "Other"))) %>%
  select(zoning, zone_class, description, permits_total, all_of(permit_types))

# Zoning popups are built in the browser too. Descriptions repeat across
# polygons, so each polygon just points at its entry in a list of them.
zone_descriptions <- unique(na.omit(zoning_map$description))
zoning_popup <- list(
  zone = zoning_map$zoning,
  desc = match(zoning_map$description, zone_descriptions) - 1L,
  descriptions = zone_descriptions,
  permits_total = zoning_map$permits_total,
  permits = unname(lapply(permit_types, \(t) zoning_map[[t]]))
)

# Only permits with coordinates can go on the map (about half of the 2024+
# permits have none; they still count in the zoning tables above).
permits_map <- permits %>%
  filter(!st_is_empty(geometry))
permit_popup <- list(
  type = permits_map$building_type,
  desc = permits_map$job_description,
  date = as.character(permits_map$permit_date)
)

zoning_colour <- colorFactor(
  palette = c("#fee391", "#fec44f", "#fe9929", "#d95f0e", "#993404",
              "#e7298a", "#7570b3", "#1b9e77", "#bdbdbd"),
  domain = zoning_map$zone_class
)

permit_map <- leaflet(Edmonton,
        # Fill most of the browser window instead of leaflet's default 400px
        width = "100%", height = "85vh",
        options = leafletOptions(
          preferCanvas = TRUE,
          # Safari's WebKit engine handles the CSS-transform zoom/pan animation
          # much worse than Chrome/Firefox once thousands of canvas features are
          # on screen -- it tends to stutter or momentarily lock up mid-animation.
          # Turning the animation off makes zoom/pan an instant redraw instead,
          # which is a bit less smooth-looking but far more reliable in Safari.
          markerZoomAnimation = FALSE,
          fadeAnimation = FALSE
        )) |>
  addTiles(urlTemplate = carto_url, attribution = carto_attr,
           options = tileOptions(updateWhenZooming = FALSE, updateWhenIdle = TRUE)) |>
  addFullscreenControl() |>
  # Census blocks go in before the permits, in the same (default) pane, so
  # they share one canvas: permit dots draw on top and both stay clickable.
  addPolygons(
    data = db_census_map,
    fillColor = census_layers[[1]]$colours,
    fillOpacity = 0.6,
    color = "white",
    weight = 0.3,
    group = "Census blocks",
    # Row in census_popup / census_colours, used by onRender
    options = pathOptions(row = seq_len(nrow(db_census_map)) - 1)
  ) |>
  # Zoning sits above the census blocks (hidden by default); its legend is
  # tied to the group so it only shows while zoning is switched on.
  addPolygons(
    data = zoning_map,
    fillColor = ~zoning_colour(zone_class),
    fillOpacity = 0.6,
    color = "white",
    weight = 0.3,
    group = "Zoning",
    options = pathOptions(row = seq_len(nrow(zoning_map)) - 1)
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    data = zoning_map,
    position = "bottomleft",
    pal = zoning_colour,
    values = ~zone_class,
    title = "Zoning",
    opacity = 0.7,
    group = "Zoning"
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    data = permits,
    "bottomleft",
    pal = permit_colour,
    values = ~`building_type`,
    title = "Permit Type"
  ) |> 
  add_census_legends() |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = permits_map,
    radius = 3,
    fillColor = ~permit_colour(building_type),
    stroke = FALSE,
    fillOpacity = 0.8,
    group = "Building Permits",
    options = pathOptions(row = seq_len(nrow(permits_map)) - 1)
  ) |>
  # Stats are base groups (radio buttons, one at a time). The groups themselves
  # are empty; picking one recolours the shared census polygons in onRender.
  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups = census_labels,
    overlayGroups = c("Census blocks", "Zoning", "Building Permits"),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  ) |>
  hideGroup(c(census_labels[-1], "Zoning")) |>
  onRender("
    function(el, x, data) {
      var map = this;
      var active = data.keys[0];

      function showLegend(key) {
        el.querySelectorAll('.census-legend').forEach(function(lg) {
          lg.style.display = (key && lg.classList.contains('legend-' + key)) ? '' : 'none';
        });
      }

      var census = map.layerManager.getLayerGroup('Census blocks', false);
      var zoning = map.layerManager.getLayerGroup('Zoning', false);
      var permits = map.layerManager.getLayerGroup('Building Permits', false);

      function recolour(key) {
        active = key;
        var c = data.colours[key];
        census.eachLayer(function(layer) {
          layer.setStyle({ fillColor: c.pal[c.idx[layer.options.row]] });
        });
        showLegend(key);
      }

      // Popups, built when opened from the columns in data
      function na(v, s) { return v === null || v === undefined ? 'n/a' : s; }
      function num(v, digits) {
        return na(v, Number(v).toLocaleString('en-US', {
          minimumFractionDigits: digits || 0, maximumFractionDigits: digits || 0 }));
      }
      function pct(v) { return na(v, v + '%'); }
      function permitLines(counts, i) {
        return data.permit_types.map(function(t, k) {
          return t + ': ' + counts[k][i] + '<br>';
        }).join('');
      }

      var cp = data.census;
      function censusPopup(i) {
        return '<b>Dissemination block ' + cp.db[i] + '</b><br>' +
          '<span style=\"color:#666\">Density is for this block; everything else is for its ' +
          'dissemination area (' + cp.da[i] + ').</span><br><br>' +
          '<b>Population:</b> ' + num(cp.pop[i]) + '<br>' +
          '<b>Population density:</b> ' + num(cp.pop_density[i]) + ' /km²<br>' +
          '<b>Dwelling density:</b> ' + num(cp.dwelling_density[i]) + ' /km²<br><br>' +
          '<b>Dwelling type</b><br>' +
          'Single-detached: ' + pct(cp.single[i]) + '<br>' +
          'Semi-detached: ' + pct(cp.semi[i]) + '<br>' +
          'Row house: ' + pct(cp.row[i]) + '<br>' +
          'Duplex apartment: ' + pct(cp.duplex[i]) + '<br>' +
          'Low-rise apartment (&lt;5 storeys): ' + pct(cp.lowrise[i]) + '<br>' +
          'Tower (5+ storeys): ' + pct(cp.tower[i]) + '<br>' +
          'Average dwelling age (est.): ' + num(cp.dwelling_age[i]) + ' yrs<br><br>' +
          '<b>Median household income:</b> ' + na(cp.income[i], '$' + num(cp.income[i])) + '<br>' +
          '<b>Immigrants:</b> ' + pct(cp.immigrant[i]) + '<br>' +
          '<b>Non-permanent residents:</b> ' + pct(cp.non_permanent[i]) + '<br>' +
          '<b>Median age:</b> ' + num(cp.median_age[i], 1) + '<br>' +
          '<b>Children (0-14):</b> ' + pct(cp.age_0_14[i]) + '<br>' +
          '<b>Seniors (65+):</b> ' + pct(cp.age_65plus[i]) + '<br>' +
          '<b>Owners / renters:</b> ' + pct(cp.owner[i]) + ' / ' + pct(cp.renter[i]) + '<br><br>' +
          '<b>New-build permits since 2024 (this block): ' + cp.permits_total[i] + '</b><br>' +
          permitLines(cp.permits, i);
      }

      var zp = data.zoning;
      function zoningPopup(i) {
        var d = zp.desc[i];
        return '<b>Zone:</b> ' + zp.zone[i] + '<br>' +
          (d === null ? '' : zp.descriptions[d] + '<br>') +
          '<br><b>New-build permits since 2024 (this area): ' + zp.permits_total[i] + '</b><br>' +
          permitLines(zp.permits, i);
      }

      var pp = data.permits;
      function permitPopup(i) {
        return '<b>Building Type:</b> ' + pp.type[i] + '<br>' +
          '<b>Description:</b> ' + pp.desc[i] + '<br>' +
          '<b>Date:</b> ' + pp.date[i] + '<br>';
      }

      [[census, censusPopup, { closeOnClick: false, maxHeight: 400 }],
       [zoning, zoningPopup, {}],
       [permits, permitPopup, { closeOnClick: false }]].forEach(function(g) {
        g[0].eachLayer(function(layer) {
          layer.bindPopup(function(l) { return g[1](l.options.row); }, g[2]);
        });
      });

      // Census blocks and zoning are mutually exclusive: switching one on
      // switches the other off. The swap waits until the layers control has
      // finished handling the click; otherwise it doesn't refresh its
      // checkboxes and the next click undoes the swap.
      function swap(show, hide) {
        setTimeout(function() {
          if (map.hasLayer(hide)) map.removeLayer(hide);
          if (!map.hasLayer(show)) map.addLayer(show);
        }, 0);
      }

      map.on('baselayerchange', function(e) {
        var i = data.labels.indexOf(e.name);
        if (i >= 0) {
          recolour(data.keys[i]);
          // Picking a census stat brings the census blocks back over zoning
          swap(census, zoning);
        }
      });
      // Hide the legend while the census blocks are switched off
      map.on('overlayremove', function(e) {
        if (e.name === 'Census blocks') showLegend(null);
      });
      map.on('overlayadd', function(e) {
        if (e.name === 'Census blocks') {
          showLegend(active);
          swap(census, zoning);
        }
        if (e.name === 'Zoning') swap(zoning, census);
      });

      recolour(active);
    }
  ", data = list(keys = census_keys, labels = census_labels,
                 colours = census_colours, census = census_popup,
                 zoning = zoning_popup, permits = permit_popup,
                 permit_types = permit_types))

# Write at most 5 decimals (~1 m) to the page instead of full precision
attr(permit_map$x, "TOJSON_ARGS") <- list(digits = 5, use_signif = FALSE)
